sname: 長編ストーリー（連続再生向け）
title: 長編ストーリー（前編・中編・後編）

items.en: I got nervous and left an hour ahead. I walked around the block twice.
items.jp: 緊張して1時間早く出た。ブロックを2周したよ。
items.speak: I got nervous and left an hour ahead. I walked around the block twice.

items.en: Here's your badge, and lemme show you where you're sitting.
items.jp: これがバッジで、席を案内するね。
items.speak: Here's your badge, and lemme show you where you're sitting.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:案内を始める時

items.en: Tell 'em you're new, and they'll set up everything.
items.jp: 新人だと言えば、全部設定してくれるよ。
items.speak: Tell 'em you're new, and they'll set up everything.
items.note: 元の形: them／聞こえ方: エム／使う場面:人をくだけて指す時

items.en: Just your name, your last job, and one fun fact. Don't overthink it.
items.jp: 名前と前の仕事と豆知識を一つだけ。考えすぎないで。
items.speak: Just your name, your last job, and one fun fact. Don't overthink it.

items.en: Skip the Thursday curry. Trust me.
items.jp: 木曜のカレーは避けて。信じて。
items.speak: Skip the Thursday curry. Trust me.

items.en: We ship every two weeks, and the deadlines are real.
items.jp: 2週間ごとにリリースで、締め切りは本物だよ。
items.speak: We ship every two weeks, and the deadlines are real.

items.en: Nobody expects you to stay late. Burnout's real.
items.jp: 誰も遅くまで残ることは期待してない。燃え尽きは現実にある。
items.speak: Nobody expects you to stay late. Burnout's real.

items.en: Blunt, but fair. Nobody's trying to make you feel small.
items.jp: 率直だけど公平。誰も君を小さく見せようとはしない。
items.speak: Blunt, but fair. Nobody's trying to make you feel small.

items.en: Did you send an email to the whole company a few minutes ago?
items.jp: 数分前に、全社員にメールを送った？
items.speak: Did you send an email to the whole company a few minutes ago?

items.en: Everybody's done it once. You survived day one. That's the only goal.
items.jp: みんな一度はやるよ。初日を乗り切った。目標はそれだけだ。
items.speak: Everybody's done it once. You survived day one. That's the only goal.

items.en: I'm gonna go home before I send another one.
items.jp: もう1通送る前に帰るよ。
items.speak: I'm gonna go home before I send another one.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:これからやると言う時

items.en: I know I'm really late. My flight was delayed four hours.
items.jp: ひどく遅くなってごめんなさい。フライトが4時間遅れて。
items.speak: I know I'm really late. My flight was delayed four hours.

items.en: Room service's open until midnight, even though the kitchen closed at ten.
items.jp: 厨房は10時で閉まったけど、ルームサービスは夜中まで開いてる。
items.speak: Room service's open until midnight, even though the kitchen closed at ten.

items.en: The first train's at five thirty. Day passes are at the front desk.
items.jp: 始発は5時半。1日券はフロントで買える。
items.speak: The first train's at five thirty. Day passes are at the front desk.

items.en: Lemme warn you, I'm a light sleeper. Is the room facing the street?
items.jp: 先に言っておくと、眠りが浅いんだ。部屋は通り側？
items.speak: Lemme warn you, I'm a light sleeper. Is the room facing the street?
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:前置きを言う時

items.en: My map's not working. Is the old market far from here?
items.jp: 地図が動かない。古い市場はここから遠い？
items.speak: My map's not working. Is the old market far from here?

items.en: It's kinda far. Maybe thirty minutes on foot.
items.jp: ちょっと遠いね。歩いて30分くらいかな。
items.speak: It's kinda far. Maybe thirty minutes on foot.
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:やんわり言う時

items.en: Buy a ticket first, at the kiosk. It's cheaper, and the driver doesn't take big bills.
items.jp: 先に売店で切符を買って。安いし、運転手は高額紙幣を受けつけない。
items.speak: Buy a ticket first, at the kiosk. It's cheaper, and the driver doesn't take big bills.

items.en: Look for a small place with a blue door, and ask for the fish soup.
items.jp: 青いドアの小さな店を探して、魚のスープを頼んで。
items.speak: Look for a small place with a blue door, and ask for the fish soup.

items.en: Watch your bag at the market. It gets crowded.
items.jp: 市場ではバッグに気をつけて。混むから。
items.speak: Watch your bag at the market. It gets crowded.

items.en: Gimme a sec. I think there's a problem with my airport shuttle.
items.jp: ちょっと待って。空港シャトルに問題があるみたい。
items.speak: Gimme a sec. I think there's a problem with my airport shuttle.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう時

items.en: The schedule changed this morning, and we should've called you.
items.jp: 今朝、時刻が変更になって、お電話すべきでした。
items.speak: The schedule changed this morning, and we should've called you.

items.en: Is seven thirty gonna be too late for a ten o'clock flight?
items.jp: 10時のフライトに、7時半では遅すぎる？
items.speak: Is seven thirty gonna be too late for a ten o'clock flight?
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:心配を伝える時

items.en: I can arrange a taxi at our expense, leaving in ten minutes.
items.jp: 当方の負担でタクシーを手配でき、10分後に出発できます。
items.speak: I can arrange a taxi at our expense, leaving in ten minutes.

items.en: It gets a lot of natural light. The living room faces south.
items.jp: 自然光がたっぷり入ります。リビングは南向きです。
items.speak: It gets a lot of natural light. The living room faces south.

items.en: The rent's twelve hundred, utilities not included.
items.jp: 家賃は1200ドルで、光熱費は別です。
items.speak: The rent's twelve hundred, utilities not included.

items.en: The owner might drop it to eleven fifty if you sign for two years.
items.jp: 2年契約なら、オーナーが1150ドルに下げるかもしれません。
items.speak: The owner might drop it to eleven fifty if you sign for two years.

items.en: Is the street loud at night? The windows are double-glazed.
items.jp: 夜は通りがうるさい？窓は二重ガラスです。
items.speak: Is the street loud at night? The windows are double-glazed.

items.en: I gotta be honest, I really like it. When do you need an answer?
items.jp: 正直、とても気に入りました。いつまでに返事が必要ですか？
items.speak: I gotta be honest, I really like it. When do you need an answer?
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:本音を言う時

items.en: Bring your ID and the first month's rent tomorrow at ten.
items.jp: 明日の10時に、身分証と1か月目の家賃を持ってきて。
items.speak: Bring your ID and the first month's rent tomorrow at ten.

items.en: The deposit's refundable when you move out, as long as there's no damage.
items.jp: 敷金は、傷みがなければ、退去時に返金されます。
items.speak: The deposit's refundable when you move out, as long as there's no damage.

items.en: I just wanna hang a few shelves. Is that okay?
items.jp: 棚を2、3個つけたいだけ。いいですか？
items.speak: I just wanna hang a few shelves. Is that okay?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:やりたいことを言う時

items.en: Shelves are okay, as long as you patch the holes when you leave.
items.jp: 棚は大丈夫、出る時に穴を埋めてくれれば。
items.speak: Shelves are okay, as long as you patch the holes when you leave.

items.en: I just moved into 5C. I wanted to say hello and apologize for the boxes.
items.jp: 5Cに引っ越してきました。あいさつと、箱のおわびをしたくて。
items.speak: I just moved into 5C. I wanted to say hello and apologize for the boxes.

items.en: Take the legs off the couch, and tilt it. Everybody has that problem.
items.jp: ソファの脚を外して傾けて。みんなそれで困るの。
items.speak: Take the legs off the couch, and tilt it. Everybody has that problem.

items.en: Recycling is on Thursdays, and the janitor gets grumpy if you mess it up.
items.jp: リサイクルは木曜で、間違えると管理人さんが不機嫌になる。
items.speak: Recycling is on Thursdays, and the janitor gets grumpy if you mess it up.

items.en: If I'm ever too loud, just knock. I won't be offended.
items.jp: うるさかったら、ノックして。気を悪くしないから。
items.speak: If I'm ever too loud, just knock. I won't be offended.

items.en: Dunno. I've never been in this part of town.
items.jp: さあ。この辺りには来たことがないんだ。
items.speak: Dunno. I've never been in this part of town.
items.note: 元の形: I don't know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:知らないと言う時

items.en: Beats me why the shuttle changed its schedule.
items.jp: なぜシャトルの時刻が変わったのか分からない。
items.speak: Beats me why the shuttle changed its schedule.
items.note: 元の形: it beats me／聞こえ方: ビーツミー／使う場面:理由が分からない時

items.en: Ya think the owner'll lower the rent?
items.jp: オーナーは家賃を下げてくれると思う？
items.speak: Ya think the owner'll lower the rent?
items.note: 元の形: do you think／聞こえ方: ヤ シンク／使う場面:意見を聞く時

items.en: Whatcha doing here so early? The office doesn't open till nine.
items.jp: こんなに早く何してるの？事務所は9時まで開かないよ。
items.speak: Whatcha doing here so early? The office doesn't open till nine.
items.note: 元の形: what are you／聞こえ方: ワッチャ／使う場面:気軽に聞く時

items.en: Didja see the welcome thread? Half the company replied.
items.jp: 歓迎のスレッド見た？会社の半分が返信してるよ。
items.speak: Didja see the welcome thread? Half the company replied.
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:出来事を伝える時

items.en: We hafta leave for the airport by seven thirty.
items.jp: 7時半までに空港に向けて出なきゃ。
items.speak: We hafta leave for the airport by seven thirty.
items.note: 元の形: have to／聞こえ方: ハフタ／使う場面:期限を言う時

items.en: Y'know, I didn't expect people to be this nice.
items.jp: ほら、こんなに親切にしてもらえるとは思ってなかった。
items.speak: Y'know, I didn't expect people to be this nice.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:しみじみ言う時

items.en: Long story short, I got the apartment, and I start Monday.
items.jp: 要するに、部屋が決まって、月曜から始まる。
items.speak: Long story short, I got the apartment, and I start Monday.

items.en: Look, you survived day one. Go home and get some rest.
items.jp: いいかい、初日は乗り切った。帰ってゆっくり休んで。
items.speak: Look, you survived day one. Go home and get some rest.

items.en: I mean, it's a great place, but it's a bit pricey.
items.jp: つまり、素敵な場所だけど、少し高いってこと。
items.speak: I mean, it's a great place, but it's a bit pricey.

items.en: No can do. The shuttle's full until eight.
items.jp: それは無理だね。シャトルは8時まで満席だよ。
items.speak: No can do. The shuttle's full until eight.

items.en: Sounds good. See you tomorrow at ten.
items.jp: いいね。明日の10時に会おう。
items.speak: Sounds good. See you tomorrow at ten.

items.en: C'mon, I'll show you where the laundry room is.
items.jp: ほら、洗濯室の場所を教えるよ。
items.speak: C'mon, I'll show you where the laundry room is.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:促す時
